questions.q: The landmark civilian nuclear cooperation pact, known as the "123 Agreement", was signed between which two countries?
questions.explain: The 123 Agreement is a civilian nuclear cooperation agreement signed between India and the United States under Section 123 of the U.S. Atomic Energy Act. It enabled civil nuclear trade between the two countries.
